purpose: Provides scoring functions to evaluate rally and contact detection quality. Compares detected spans and contacts against ground-truth data, computing metrics like boundary coverage, alignment offsets, count gates, and precision/recall across frame tolerances.

public_api.name: RallyBoundary
public_api.role: StrEnum classifying how a GT rally's strokes land relative to detected spans: COVERED (all in one span), SPLIT (across 2+ spans or outside), MISSED (no spans contain any stroke)

public_api.name: GtRally
public_api.role: NamedTuple holding one ground-truth rally: set label, rally number, and frame list of its strokes. Provides extent and n_strokes properties.

public_api.name: load_gt_rallies
public_api.role: Load and group strokes from shots_master into GT rallies for a single video, returning list of GtRally objects sorted by (set_id, rally)

public_api.name: merged_span_indices
public_api.role: Identify detected spans that fully contain 2+ GT rally extents, indicating a span has merged multiple rallies into one detection

public_api.name: classify_rally_boundary
public_api.role: Classify a single GT rally as COVERED/SPLIT/MISSED and return the span index if covered, or None otherwise

public_api.name: classify_all
public_api.role: Apply rally boundary classification to all GT rallies in bulk, returning list of (boundary, span_idx) tuples parallel to gt_rallies input

public_api.name: score_boundaries
public_api.role: Compute rally-level metrics: count of covered/split/missed rallies, merged and spurious spans, start/end frame alignment offsets for covered rallies

public_api.name: greedy_match
public_api.role: One-to-one match candidates to GT frames within tolerance, greedily claiming closest pairs first; used for per-rally contact matching

public_api.name: strict_contact_rows
public_api.role: Generate detailed matching rows for covered rallies only, showing matched/unmatched contacts and GT strokes at multiple tolerances; used for strict evaluation

public_api.name: wide_edge_contact_rows
public_api.role: Generate diagnostic rows for first/last stroke of each rally within wide time windows, matching candidates globally; used for boundary-edge analysis

public_api.name: score_contacts
public_api.role: Compute contact-level metrics: count gate (candidates == strokes), per-tolerance precision/recall/F1 overall and per-set, accounting for merged spans and spurious candidates
